name: Fintoch
rootCause: In May 2023, the Fintoch DeFi platform on Binance Smart Chain executed a rug pull, draining approximately $31.6 million in USDT from user deposits. The platform used a false identity, fabricated claims of institutional backing, and moved the illicit proceeds across chains for laundering. The Fintoch platform's smart contracts and admin-controlled funds enabled the operators to drain all user deposits. The project maintained full privileged control, used deceptive marketing and identities, and abruptly withdrew assets, leaving investors with worthless tokens and no recourse.
